Direction: FÓLIOS ABERTOS. The webpage itself is one open ancient codex spread viewed straight-on: exactly two pages, one central stitched gutter, a narrow leather edge and irregular parchment page edges. No surrounding tabletop or props. The left leaf carries the offer and strong wine-red button; the right leaf introduces the founders in a quiet book colophon and an asymmetric first portfolio placement. Let the portfolio begin in the lower part of the spread with both supplied screenshots as inserted printed plates of different prominence, with their captions. The one dominant gesture is the open spread, not ornament. Parchment #E9DCC1 is the ground, ink #26211D the readable text, wine #7C3038 actions, olive #5D624B annotations, muted gold #B19559 fine binding detail. Generous readable typography, restrained fine natural paper grain, convincing binding, calm whitespace.
